ARTWORK_ONE.TITLE: Artwork One
ARTWORK_ONE.STATUS_DOC: Whether Artwork One is the interface this player serves. Switch it here, or under Settings → System → User Interface layout design; the page reloads in the chosen interface.
ARTWORK_ONE.SWITCH_BACK: Switch back to the previous interface
ARTWORK_ONE.SETTINGS_DOC: The theme (dark, light, system), the ambient display and the pins are set under Settings → Appearance while Artwork One is the active interface. They are kept on the player, for every screen it drives.
ARTWORK_ONE.ACTIVE: Artwork One is the active interface
ARTWORK_ONE.INACTIVE: Another interface is active; Artwork One is ready
ARTWORK_ONE.SWITCHED: Artwork One is now the interface
